user: DB freshness checks are now unambiguous — synced_at's clock skew and all-row rewrites are documented so nobody chases a phantom sync bug.
what: New learning documenting that synced_at runs ~4 days ahead of wall clock and every sync pass touches all rows; the right freshness signal is the embedding gap.
why: Prevents future misdiagnosis of the sync as broken or 'from the future' when checking whether the DB is up to date.
summary: Recorded learning: bookmarks.synced_at runs ~4 days ahead of wall clock (skewed sync-source clock, but monotonic), and the external Raindrop sync rewrites synced_at on every row each pass — so synced_at vs now() is useless for staleness and 'recently synced' counts can't find new bookmarks; use the embedding gap (bookmarks vs embeddings count) instead. Cross-linked to the existing mirror/sync learnings and the embed cron entity.

user: Search now understands what a page actually does — conversational queries find tools by their content, not just title and tags
what: The ranking stage now reads the first ~1200 characters of each bookmarked page, so results whose relevance lives in the page body (e.g. MotionClone for "process videos and edit them") surface instead of being cut
why: Previously a tool could be found by semantic search but dropped at the final ranking step because the ranker only saw title/purpose/excerpt/tags — the actual signal was in the page content

summary: Extended the pool-then-rerank rule with a "mirror the embedder's input" bullet: always feed the cross-encoder the same enriched text the embedder sees (title+purpose+excerpt+tags+~1200 chars of page content). what: Wiki: added an Entity page for the bookmark archetype system plus three implementation learnings (sql.json() for jsonb writes, the 0.45 relevance-floor calibration, Svelte 5 stale-capture/$derived).
why: Future sessions need to know the archetype classifier is deterministic and app-owned, why the floor is 0.45, and the jsonb/Svelte gotchas — so they don't re-derive them.
summary: Documented the newly built bookmark archetype system (30 canonical archetypes, deterministic regex classifier, JSONB on te9_dev.bookmark_archetypes, 3,764/3,764 backfilled) as an Entity page. Captured three learnings from the implementation: postgres-js double-encodes plain strings sent to jsonb (use sql.json()), the rerank relevance floor 0.45 was calibrated to sit exactly in the measured gap between nonsense-query scores (≤0.36) and genuine matches (≥0.45), and Svelte 5 values captured in plain consts go stale across param navigation (use $derived).
